presenter_desk.name: Presenter Desk
presenter_desk.description: Elena Voss's mahogany desk. Overturned coffee mug, notepad, and mic.

overturned_chair.name: Overturned Chair
overturned_chair.description: The chair is pushed backward violently, implying a sudden struggle.

shattered_mug.name: Shattered Mug
shattered_mug.description: Elena's coffee mug lies shattered on the floor. Dregs of coffee spilled.

notebook.name: Reporter Notebook
notebook.description: Elena's notebook contains references to missing files and a security code note: 'PC Code: 1003'

strange_symbol.name: Under-desk Symbol
strange_symbol.description: Scribbled under the desk wood is a hand-drawn emblem: a circle intersected by a red thread.

scaffolding_herring.name: Studio Scaffolding
scaffolding_herring.description: The metal scaffolding holding up the spot lights. Everything is in order; nothing of interest.

studio_floor.name: Studio Floor
studio_floor.description: The concrete floor surrounding the cameras.

lens.name: Shattered Camera Lens
lens.description: The glass lens of Studio Camera 2 is smashed, as if kicked during a scuffle.

blood_trail.name: Faint Blood Trail
blood_trail.description: A drop of blood on the concrete floor, leading from the desk to the main exit door.

console.name: Editing Console
console.description: Control panel for video mixers and feeds. On it sits a tape recorder.

tape_recorder.name: Corrupted Audio Tape
tape_recorder.description: A tape recorder containing Elena's final interview tape, but the file is corrupted. Rearranging the blocks in Analysis might restore it.

monitors_herring.name: Monitor Panel
monitors_herring.description: A grid of monitors showing empty broadcasting rooms. Nothing of interest here.

servers.name: Server Racks
servers.description: Humming server columns hosting security logs.

power_logs.name: Station Power Logs
power_logs.description: System log files indicating there was never a power cut in the station, only a manual recording freeze.

keycard_logs.name: Studio A Keycard Logs
keycard_logs.description: Access logs indicating the Producer's keycard was swiped at 10:02 PM, and the Security Chief's master key card swiped at 10:12 PM.

keycard_panel_herring.name: Telecom Switchboard
keycard_panel_herring.description: Bundles of Ethernet cables routing local desk phones. Nothing of value to the murder.

spot_12.name: Parking Spot 12
spot_12.description: Spot 12 is designated for TV guests.

parking_receipt.name: Discarded Receipt
parking_receipt.description: A parking ticket stub dated today, stamped at 9:55 PM and departing at 10:15 PM.

gate_receipt_herring.name: Trash Bin
gate_receipt_herring.description: A plastic bin near the parking elevator. Contains empty soda cans and coffee cups. Nothing of interest.

loft_desk.name: Loft Desk
loft_desk.description: Elena Voss's desk with notebooks and a drawer.

usb_flash_drive.name: Encrypted Flash Drive
usb_flash_drive.description: A silver USB flash drive found in her desk drawer. It is password encrypted.

bookshelf_herring.name: Messy Bookshelf
bookshelf_herring.description: Dozens of textbooks on law, investigative journalism, and financial crime. Nothing of interest to the murder.
